paper.title: Self-Evolving GPT: A Lifelong Autonomous Experiential Learner

signatures.object: Persistent task-specific Procedure and Suggestions memory, initially empty
signatures.information: Current user input, generated task descriptions, top5 identity/top10 transfer candidates, Wikipedia snippets truncated512 tokens, five generated practices and model correctness judgments
signatures.operation: Categorize→transfer→practice→contrast correct/incorrect→induce→merge/deduplicate→replace experience→reason; skip learning after three zero-error practice stages
signatures.output: Task names/descriptions and up to20 suggestions/procedure insights per prompt
signatures.conditions: Recurring related tasks, capable categorizer and sufficiently accurate web-grounded self-verifier
signatures.feedback: Generated practice answer correctness labels produced by model with reference; gold test labels evaluation only
signatures.selection_rule: Merge/replace learned text; discard inconclusive practice; skip based on zero wrong examples three times
signatures.selection_data: Online test inputs and generated pseudoquestions, not gold test labels
signatures.persistence: Experience memory survives user queries and transfers across generated tasks
signatures.later_use: Subsequent stream questions retrieve task experience
signatures.claimed_effect: Average accuracy +3.8/+5.3 percentage points for GPT-3.5/GPT-4
signatures.failure_boundary: Self-verifier noise, web contamination, reasoning/knowledge gaps, high token cost; external execution examples missing
